proposed_ledger_entry: Item 321 computes the exact Casoratian of the actual Item-317 residue solutions A_s,Z_s,conjugate(Z_s). It proves a closed product formula and shows that reduction can fail only on the unique h=1 boundary row or when p_s divides Q(s)=660s^2+1600s+779. The division-free identity Q(s)-8(330M^2-235M+18)=5(66s-132M+127)(4M+2s+1) confines all nonfundamental rows to O(log M) mass. Every one of the eight actual period quadrics factors over Q(i,sqrt(2)) as (A+i ell)(A-i ell), where both factors are genuine solutions of the same common operator; together with Z they form a fundamental basis, because the basis-change determinant has absolute norm 64 or 8 and is a p-unit for all actual p>=13. The Item-308 norm algebra is split modulo every actual prime, so Frobenius supplies no simultaneous-factor zero. Transported quadratic invariants are coordinate pullbacks by the fundamental matrix, and regular single-row common-operator elimination gives the zero ideal via an explicit invertible isotropic state. Substitution of the actual initial state returns only the raw O(M^2)-height union product. This is a scoped operator-elimination no-go, not a no-go for new arithmetic of the actual initial values and not a claim that a factor vanishes on the actual orbit. Booking is zero; W_D(M) and the 1/36 ceiling remain open.
